recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style studio portrait of a male figure against a deep blue textured background, featuring a vertical decorative border of colorful polka dots and a mix of bold outlined sans-serif and casual script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center balanced by right-aligned text and a vertical graphic strip.
Contrast between the cool blue background and the warm, vibrant polka dots.
Hierarchy established by large-scale header text and secondary script sub-header.
Visual weight anchored by the dark silhouette of the subject's trousers.
coreInvariants: Vertical black strip on the right edge containing multi-colored circles
Combination of outlined block capitals and yellow script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait, subject standing at a 3/4 angle, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow script text in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top header, down the subject's profile, to the script title, and finally to the vertical dot pattern on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space around the subject to allow for typographic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and navy blue background with a subtle floor vignette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black vertical strip on the far right edge.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink, orange, and cyan polka dots; bright yellow for script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a moody, medium-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Header uses heavy-weight, condensed geometric capitals with a thin white outline.
Sub-header uses a fluid, upright brush script with rounded terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'H' in the header are tightly tracked to create a solid horizontal block.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the background, behind the subject's hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, architectural sans-serif with a soft, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed geometric feel of the header.
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a young man in 1960s attire (striped shirt, dark trousers) against a textured blue wall. Include a solid black vertical strip on the far right edge populated with flat, colorful circles in pink, orange, and cyan.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large outlined sans-serif title across the top. Add a three-line yellow script title in the center-right negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the header text outlined and uppercase?
Is the script text yellow and centered on the right?
Does the vertical dot strip contain at least three distinct colors?
Is the background a textured blue vignette?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the outline on the header is consistent.
Ensure the script text is legible against the blue.
Verify the dots are perfectly circular and flat.
Confirm the subject does not overlap the right-side dot strip.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Textured Blue Vignette + [Outlined Sans-Serif Header] + [Yellow Script Sub-header] + Vertical Polka Dot Border
